cause.mechanism: The native TRAIN allocator emitted all 13,824 selected units in its frozen allocation-id schedule, an intentional interleave across cells. The campaign converter preserved that order in selected_units, while the independent calibration boundary required the identical units in lexicographic (round, ply_bin, ratio_bin, pair_type, allocation_priority, identity) order. All quotas, identities, digests, and 216 evaluation shards were complete; calibration failed closed before fitting or any efficacy decision because the cross-module serialization order contracts disagreed.

stage.error: CalibrationError: TRAIN selected_units are not in canonical cell/priority order
stage.name: train_calibrate

remediation_constraint: A successor may only canonicalize the TRAIN selected_units JSON array after verifying the immutable allocation-id schedule and before sealing its payload digest; the allocation bindings and evaluator order remain unchanged. It must add an exact full-13,824-unit cross-module regression, use all-fresh roots, and preserve every sampling budget, adequacy criterion, safety gate, and final gate.
